title: Closed-Loop Learning-Based PID Tuning for DC Motor Actuators – physical ESP32/L298N experiment logs
authors: Lizarraga, Jorge A. | Luque-Vega, Luis F. | Ruiz-Leon, Javier | Carrasco-Navarro, Rocío | Mata-Romero, Marcela E. | Nava-Pintor, Jesús Antonio | García-Vázquez, Fabián | Solís-Sánchez, Luis O. | Guerrero-Osuna, Héctor A.
ordered_digest_definition: sort relative paths lexicographically, then SHA-256 over each lowercase 40-character Git blob hex plus LF, concatenated
counts_scope: Physical trial files only. Host state checkpoints and optimizer histories excluded. The 60-generation folder may contain reruns; 2,942 denotes distinct serialized files. Exact correspondence of individual files to paper Table 6 unresolved.

rights.scope: Root MIT license grants rights in software and associated documentation. Separate license for raw experiment data not identified. Redistributed files are independently calculated counts and author-attributed source pointers; original MAT arrays not copied.

verification: Every experiment_*.mat file read and Git blob SHA-1 checked. 121 samples/file. Signed integer u recorded after conditional integration, bounding and round-half-away, then the actuation path applies its positional deadband. Float32 firmware replay with grid-reconstructed r,y matched every logged u. Neither independently measured analog drive current/voltage nor shaft torque is exported.
firmware_locators: TunePID_L298N.ino main loop: computes C(...) and sends integer u after applying downstream policy
C.ino C and Policy: conditional integration, hard clamp, roundf and positional deadband
H.ino H and R.ino load_R: encoder grid and quantized setpoint
sampling.ino get_t_ms and experiment.ino start_experiment: scheduled time and initial row

title: InnovaPower/MitDev-Eletrica: Release with 3-Phase PMSG Dataset
authors: Rafael Noboro Tominaga (Zenodo release creator); associated data-article team listed in literature.csv
archive: Zenodo lists 2,404,737,837-byte v1.1.0 repository ZIP (depositor MD5 67bff60272c6e286ba13be274523644d); only all individual MAT blobs in PMSG-3phase-Dataset were downloaded/decoded. Other machine families excluded.

rights.release: CC BY 4.0 per Zenodo v1.1.0 metadata
rights.shared: Per-file descriptive and consistency statistics with source attribution. Neither raw archive nor original arrays copied.

verification: Every MAT blob matched source size and Git SHA-1. All 225 have 60,001 valid observations. Computed duty matches 0.5+Vphase_ref/Vdc to maximum 4.274e-8. No recorded phase duty hit 0 or 1 in 40,500,675 values, which establishes a negative comparator at those endpoints. Iq tracking error and measured-vs-reference phase voltage residuals are not evidence of a current cap.
data_limit: Table 1: Iq from measured phase currents, Iq_ref from controller, Torq_mec external mechanical torque, Torq_ele calculated electric torque, Spd reported rad/s, Package_loss an integrator reset on successful CAN reception. The engineering 20 kHz acquisition grid is not independent torque sensor refresh. Observed speed/filename and calculated/measured torque ratios are documented without unit correction or inferred pole-pair scaling; healthy files also contain a high Fault_relay command.
